verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is a hosted banking API run by a regulated financial institution. Self-hosting is a fair openness question for payment and banking platforms, but nothing in the evidence shows a deployable or self-hostable core. The GitHub SDKs are client libraries and the Sandbox is a hosted test workspace; neither is self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
